paite: Hiaite anam minte uh ahi: Mallam gamgi Tuipi Lian a kipan a Hethlon paisuak in Hamath lutna phaizang ah Damaskas gamgi a Hamath kiang mallam pang Hazar-enan pha in, suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Dante tan ahi.
heading: Namte Lak A Gam Hawmna

paite: Dante tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Asherte tan ahi.
Asherte tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Naphtalite tan ahi.
Naphtalite tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Manassehte tan ahi.
Manassehte tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Ephraimte tan ahi.
Ephraimte tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Reubente tan ahi.
Reubente tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Judahte tan ahi.
Judahte tan toh kigi in suahlam leh tumlam ah, thilpiak na lat ding uh avai tong singnih-le-sangnga ahi ding a; adung suahlam leh tumlam sang ah tan dang bangmah in ahi a, alai a mun siangthou om in.
heading: Gam Lai A Mun Poimohte

paite: Thilpiak TOUPA kiang a na lat ding uh adung tong singnih-le-sangnga, avai tong singnih ahi ding ahi.

Huan hiai ah siampute a ding in gam siangthou thilpiak ding ahi ding a; mallam ah adung tong singnih-le-sangnga leh tumlam ah avai tong singkhat leh suahlam ah avai tong singkhat, simlam ah adung tong singnih-le-sangnga ahi ding ahi. Alaizang ah TOUPA mun siangthou a-om ding hi.
Siampu siansaksa, Zadok tapate ka thu kem mite a ding ahi ding, amaute Israel suante avakmang lai ua Levi chite avakmang bang ua vakmangloute ahi uhi.
Huan gam thilpiak pumpi a kipan amau a dia piak tuam, mun siangthoupen ahi ding; Levi chi tan toh akigi in.
Siampu tan zulzul ah Levi chite'n tan anei ding ua, adung tong singnih-le-sangnga, avai tong singkhat ahi ding hi.
Huan azuak ding uh ahi kei a, akhen ding uh leng ahi sam kei; agam hoihna tata leng midang kiang a piak ding ahi kei hi; TOUPA a dia siangthou ahi ngal a.
Huan avai tong singnih-le-sangnga ban ah tong sangnga vantang tan, khopi dinna ding, tenna inn dingte leh khopuate a ding ahi ding; khopi bel alaizang a a-om ding ahi.
Huchi in ateh vialdan hichibang in ahi ding: Amallam pang tong sangli-le-zanga, asimlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga; asuahlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga, atumlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga.
Akhopi in khopua anei ding a; mallam pang in tong zanih-le-sawmnga; simlam pang tong zanih-le-sawmnga, suahlam pang tong zanih-le-sawmnga, tumlam pang tong zanih-le-sawmnga ahi.

Adunglam val lai, thilpiak siangthou zul a pen suahlam ah tong singkhat, tumlam ah tong singkhat ahi ding; thilpiak siangthousa zulzul ahi ding hi; huai a thilpawtte khopi a nasem mite nek ding ahi ding.
Huchi in khopi a nasemmi Israel nam tengteng a mite'n alei alet ding uhi.
Thilpiak pumpi adung tong singnih-le-sangnga, avai tong singnih-le-sangnga ahi ding; thilpiak siangthousa, dung leh vai kikim khopi tan toh na lat ding uh ahi.

Aval thilpiaksa siangthou leh khopi tan pang lang tuaktuak vaihawmpa tan ahi ding a, suahlam sang ah thilpiak tong singnih-le-sangnga ban, gamseh dangte zulzul vaihawmpa tan ahi ding; huchi in thilpiak siangthousa leh tempul mun siangthou bel alaizang ah a-om ding.
Huan Levi chi tan leh khopi tan vaihawmpa tante kikal ah a-om ding a; vaihawmpa tan Judah tan leh Benjamin tan toh akigi ding.
Huan nam omlaite tungthu ah, suahlam leh tumlam ah tan khat Benjaminte tan ahi ding.
Benjaminte tan toh kigi in suah leh tumlam ah tan khat Simeonte tan ahi.
Simeonte tan toh kigi in suah leh tumlam Issakarte tan ahi.
Issakarte tan toh kigi in suah leh tumlam tan khat Zebulunte tan ahi.
Zebulunte tan toh kigi in suah leh tumlam tan khat Gadte tan ahi.
Gadte tan simlam pang gamgi Tarmar a kipan in Meribah-kadesh tuite tan in Aigupta lui zui in Tuipi Lian atung ding hi.
Hiai Israel namte goutan ding a gam kihawmdan ding leh agam sehtuamte ahi uh chih Toupa PATHIAN thupawt ahi.
Huan hiaite khopi a kipan pawtnate ahi uh; mallam pang tong sangli-le-zanga ah kongpi thum;
heading: Jerusalem Kongpite

paite: khopi kongpite Israel nam min bang zel a sak ding ahi a; mallam kongpi thumte, Reuben kongpi khat, Judah kongpi khat, Levi kongpi khat;
suahlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga ah kongpi thum; Joseph kongpi khat, Benjamin kongpi khat, Dan kongpi khat ahi ding hi.
Simlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga ah kongpi thum; Simeon kongpi khat, Issakar kongpi khat, Zebulun kongpi khat ahi ding.
Tumlam pang tong sangli-le-zanga ah kongpi thum; Gad kongpi khat, Asher kongpi khat, Naphtali kongpi khat ahi ding hi.
Akimvel in tong singkhat-le-sanggiat ahi ding a; huai ni a kipan in khopi min bel, "TOUPA omna mun" chih ahi ding hi.
